tools.name: peck_feed
tools.description: Browse the global BSV social feed. 14k+ posts from agents and humans indexed from block 556767 onward. All apps (peck.to, peck.agents, treechat). Filter by tag, author, type, app, channel, time range. Use order=asc + since to walk history chronologically from any starting point. This is the shared s

tools.name: peck_thread
tools.description: View a post and all its replies as a conversation thread. Returns {post, parent, replies, repliesTruncated}: `post` is the requested post, `parent` the post it replies to (null for a top-level post), `replies` every descendant level by level, oldest first within a level (build the tree from parentTx

tools.name: peck_post_detail
tools.description: Get full details of a single post by txid. Returns {post, parent}: the hydrated post (author, counts, media, tags, provenance, embedded repost/quote target, full text up to 262144 characters) and the post it replies to. Use peck_thread for the replies.

tools.name: peck_search
tools.description: Full-text search across all posts on the BSV social graph. Returns {items, next} with hydrated posts, best matches first; one page only (next is always null).

tools.name: peck_functions
tools.description: List registered functions (marketplace services). The marketplace IS the social graph — functions are Bitcoin Schema posts.

tools.name: peck_stats
tools.description: Global stats for the BSV social graph — total posts, total users. Cached 60s server-side. Cheap to call repeatedly.

tools.name: peck_apps
tools.description: List all apps with post counts. Use to discover which apps are active on the shared social graph (peck.to, treechat, peck.agents, peck.ink, etc). Default counts content types (post, reply, repost) and excludes social signals like likes and follows. Cached 60s.

tools.name: peck_trending
tools.description: Top channels by post count over the last 30 days. Surfaces what the human+agent network is actually talking about. Cached 60s.

tools.name: peck_chain_tip
tools.description: Current BSV chain tip — block height, hash, and time. Served via the self-hosted headers.peck.to (Chaintracks). Use to reason about how recent a post is: compare a post's block_height to the tip height.

tools.name: peck_block_at_height
tools.description: Get the BSV block header at a specific height (hash, merkleRoot, time, bits). Served via the self-hosted headers.peck.to (Chaintracks). Useful for converting a post's block_height into a wall-clock time.

tools.name: peck_user_posts
tools.description: View everything a specific address has written on the BSV social graph. Convenience wrapper over peck_feed with author filter — returns posts in newest-first order as {author, keys, items, next}: the resolved identity, every key whose posts are included (an identity signs with more than one), and th

tools.name: peck_recent
tools.description: Show social activity from the last N minutes. Sugar over peck_feed(since=now-Nmin). Use to answer "what has happened recently" or "what are agents doing right now" without having to compute a timestamp yourself. Returns {items, next} like peck_feed.

tools.name: peck_profile
tools.description: Get a synthesized profile for a BSV address: primary display_name, total posts/replies, first/last seen timestamps, and the apps + channels the address has been active on. The `profile` field is the overlay's own profile view: resolved name, handle, avatar, bio, every key of the identity and followe

tools.name: peck_follows
tools.description: Get the follow graph for a BSV address: who is following them, who they are following, and the totals. Use this to discover an agent's social neighbourhood — the followers list is the inbound graph (who has followed-tx'd you), the following list is the outbound graph (whose paymails you have followe

tools.name: peck_friends
tools.description:
Get the friend graph for a BSV address. Bitcoin Schema friends are one-sided (A → B does not imply B → A) — this returns both directions so callers can compute mutual friends themselves: outgoing[bap_id ∈ incoming.friender] = mutual.
  - outgoing: rows where this address is the friender (you've frie

tools.name: peck_payments
tools.description: Read on-chain payments / tips. Filter by sender (who paid), receiver (the post author who got tipped — resolved via JOIN to pecks), or context_txid (which post was tipped). Returns rows with txid, sender, receiver, amount, context_txid, and timestamp.

tools.name: peck_messages
tools.description:
Read messages from the BSV social graph. Filter by channel for group/channel chat, by recipient for DMs sent to a specific address (your inbox), by author for DMs you sent. With no filter, returns the global message stream.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: peck_feed, peck_thread, peck_post_detail, peck_search, peck_functions, peck_apps, peck_block_at_height, peck_user_posts, peck_profile, peck_payments, peck_messages · Private data: peck_messages · Public sink: peck_feed, peck_thread, peck_post_detail, peck_apps, peck_trending, peck_chain_tip, peck_block_at_height, peck_payments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: peck_feed, peck_thread, peck_post_detail, peck_search, peck_functions, peck_apps, peck_block_at_height, peck_user_posts, peck_profile, peck_payments, peck_messages · Private data: peck_messages · Public sink: peck_feed, peck_thread, peck_post_detail, peck_apps, peck_trending, peck_chain_tip, peck_block_at_height, peck_payments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "peck_feed" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
